scope: Numerical qualification of actual FESTIM 2.2 diffusion, isotope trapping and heat adapters. Not LiT property data, full target physics, live integration or experimental qualification.
sourceTrace: src/coupled-target.ts:147-166 computes conditional Arrhenius diffusion/release, replacement and heat with custom IMEX stepping

FESTIM v2.2 HydrogenTransportProblem, HeatTransferProblem and CoupledTransientHeatTransferHydrogenTransport APIs checked in upstream source before writing adapter
need: Existing SciPy loading oracle covers a well-mixed reduced system. This pilot establishes an independent specialist runtime and common transport/heat limits before any production material-model migration.

runtime.execution: safe-dev nonroot guest only; serial thread limits; network only for installation

syntheticUnits: Unit slab length, unit concentration scale and unit time scale. Thermal temperatures in kelvin with dimensionless positive conductivity/density/capacity. All coefficients are manufactured positive values, not measured material parameters.

cases.oracle: Exact eigenmode 0.2*exp(-0.1*pi^2*t), plus independent SciPy sparse finite-volume exponential

cases.equations: R_i=2*c_i*(0.3-cDt-cTt)-0.5*c_it; dc_i/dt=-R_i; dc_it/dt=R_i; sealed uniform D/T
cases.oracle: Independent SciPy Radau and DOP853 tolerances 1e-11/1e-13; both isotope inventories constant; shared vacancies nonnegative
Exact amplitude 50*exp(-0.1*pi^2*t), plus independent SciPy sparse finite-volume exponential

cases.equations: Insulated heat dT/dt=1000; D(T)=4*exp(-0.05/(kB*T)); sealed D/T diffusion driven by actual evolving heat solution
cases.initial: T=300; same complementary D/T cosine profiles
cases.oracle: T=300+1000*t; exact mode amplitude from independent SciPy quad integral of D(T); no reaction heat feedback is asserted

gates.runtimeImports: Actual FESTIM/dolfinx/PETSc imported; pinned versions, package lock and source hashes recorded

handling: No tolerance changes after results; retain every failure. Fixed iteration count exactly finalTime/dt, and verify actual solver time rather than relying on a floating-point while-loop endpoint. Use actual per-step dt and states in exported response tables. Convergence compares differences, not error signs, avoiding cancellation between temporal and spatial truncation.
exports: all result states and convergence gates
